name: P ZERO Race (tube type)

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: The tube-type P ZERO Race page does not state where it is made.

positioning: Tube-type P ZERO Race for high-intensity training and racing, with TechBELT Road protection.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli claims SmartEVO improves grip on wet and dry asphalt over its previous compounds.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this line.

caveats: The 2021 lab sample was tested with a butyl tube; a latex or TPU tube changes rolling resistance.
Measured wet grip (60) was low for a race tire in that test.

image.shown: P ZERO Race tube-type sidewall as pictured in Pirelli's catalogue; one photo covers every width.
image.alt: Close-up of a Pirelli P ZERO Race tube-type road tire sidewall
